scope: Analytic re-derivation of the cost and success ledger of the historical unpublished Frobenius-class rho candidate for all uniform logical challenges of bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1, under tracks/docs/COST_MODEL.md (classical-group-work-v2, C=20000). No production run, provider review or official score is claimed.

heuristics: H1: random-mapping behaviour of the R-adding class walk with Brent-Pollard correction; standard rho heuristic (Pollard 1978, Teske 2001, van Oorschot-Wiener 1999, Duursma-Gaudry-Morain 1999, Wiener-Zuccherato 1998, Bos-Kleinjung-Lenstra 2010); supported by 3,096 historical toy instances (mean collision time 1.23-1.27 sqrt(N) vs 1.253-1.263 predicted; P[T<=S0] 0.375-0.410 vs 0.40 model); toy evidence valid only at toy scale; unproved.
Distinguished-point and partition bits taken from the class-key minimum are pseudo-random (standard heuristic).
Key ties counted as failure; total probability <= 2^-249.
